cookie_policy.meta_description: Cookie policy of Hovenier.frl. Information about which cookies we use and how you can manage your cookie settings.
cookie_policy.hero_subtitle: Transparent information about how we use cookies to improve your experience on Hovenier.frl
cookie_policy.intro_text: At Hovenier.frl we respect your privacy and want to be transparent about our use of cookies and similar technologies.
cookie_policy.intro_detail: This cookie policy explains which cookies we use, why we use them, and how you can manage your cookie preferences. By using our website, you agree to the use of cookies as described in this policy.
cookie_policy.definition_text_1: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device (computer, tablet, smartphone) when you visit a website. These files contain information that the website can read on a subsequent visit.
cookie_policy.definition_text_2: Cookies can be placed by the website owner themselves (first-party cookies) or by external parties such as advertisers or analytics tools (third-party cookies). They can be temporary (session cookies) which are deleted when you close your browser, or permanent (persistent cookies) which remain on your device for a specified period.
cookie_policy.definition_text_3: In addition to cookies, we also use similar technologies such as web beacons, pixels, and local storage to collect information about how you use our website.
cookie_policy.usage_text: Hovenier.frl uses cookies for various purposes to provide you with the best possible and most relevant experience on our website. Our cookies serve the following purposes:
cookie_policy.usage_essential_desc: For the proper functioning of the website and security purposes
cookie_policy.usage_experience_desc: To remember your preferences and settings for future visits
cookie_policy.usage_analytics_desc: To understand how visitors use our website and improve it
cookie_policy.usage_personalized_desc: To show relevant content and offers
cookie_policy.usage_marketing_desc: For showing relevant advertisements and measuring campaign effectiveness
cookie_policy.usage_social_desc: To enable features such as sharing and logging in via social media
cookie_policy.usage_performance_desc: To monitor and optimize the speed and performance of our website
cookie_policy.usage_footer: We only use cookies that are necessary for our services or for which you have given explicit consent, in accordance with applicable privacy and cookie legislation.
cookie_policy.types_text: We use different types of cookies on our website. Below you will find an overview of all cookie categories and the specific cookies we place:
cookie_policy.types_necessary_text: These cookies are essential for the functioning of our website and cannot be disabled without affecting the functionality of the site. They are usually only placed in response to actions you take.
cookie_policy.types_session_purpose: Purpose: Session management and user identification
cookie_policy.types_session_duration: Retention: Until end of browser session
cookie_policy.types_csrf_purpose: Purpose: Protection against Cross-Site Request Forgery attacks
cookie_policy.types_analytical_text: These cookies help us understand how visitors use our website by collecting information about pages visited, error messages, and other website interactions. All data is collected anonymously.
cookie_policy.types_ga_purpose: Purpose: Google Analytics tracking for traffic measurement and user behavior
cookie_policy.types_gid_purpose: Purpose: Distinguishing between different website users
cookie_policy.types_gat_purpose: Purpose: Limiting the number of requests to Google Analytics
cookie_policy.types_functional_text: These cookies enable extra functionalities and provide a personalized experience. They remember your choices and preferences.
cookie_policy.types_region_purpose: Purpose: Remembering your location preferences for relevant gardeners
cookie_policy.types_marketing_text: These cookies are used for showing relevant advertisements and measuring advertising effectiveness. We ask for your explicit consent for these cookies.
cookie_policy.types_fb_purpose: Purpose: Facebook Pixel tracking for advertising purposes
cookie_policy.types_ads_purpose: Purpose: Measuring advertising conversions and ROI
cookie_policy.management_text: You have various options to manage your cookie preferences. You can withdraw or change your consent for non-essential cookies at any time.
cookie_policy.management_center_text: The easiest way to change your cookie preferences is via our Cookie Center. You can access this center via:
cookie_policy.management_center_banner: The cookie banner that appears on your first visit
cookie_policy.management_center_footer: The "Cookie Settings" link in the footer of every page
cookie_policy.management_center_note: In the Cookie Center you can indicate per category whether you want to accept or reject these cookies. Necessary cookies cannot be disabled.
cookie_policy.management_browser_text: You can also manage cookies directly via your web browser settings. Each browser has its own method for cookie management:
cookie_policy.management_browser_note: Please note: blocking cookies via your browser blocks all cookies for all websites, not just Hovenier.frl.
cookie_policy.management_optout_text: For some third-party cookies you can use specific opt-out tools:
cookie_policy.management_consequences_text: Disabling certain cookies may affect your experience on our website:
cookie_policy.management_consequences_necessary_desc: Cannot be disabled without loss of basic functionality
cookie_policy.management_consequences_functional_desc: Your preferences will not be remembered (language, region, etc.)
cookie_policy.management_consequences_analytical_desc: We cannot optimize the website as well for users
cookie_policy.management_consequences_marketing_desc: Advertisements may be less relevant to your interests
cookie_policy.management_consequences_footer: Even after disabling cookies, the basic functionality of our website remains available. You can still search for gardeners, contact us and request quotes.
cookie_policy.management_warning_text: When you delete cookies from your browser, your cookie preferences are also deleted. On your next visit you will be asked again to set your preferences.
cookie_policy.consent_text: Placing cookies on your device requires a valid legal basis under the GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and the Dutch Telecommunications Act. We use different legal bases depending on the type of cookie.
cookie_policy.consent_legal_necessary_desc: Legitimate interest - essential for the functioning of the website
cookie_policy.consent_legal_functional_desc: Consent - you give explicit consent for these
cookie_policy.consent_legal_analytical_desc: Consent - only placed after your explicit agreement
cookie_policy.consent_legal_marketing_desc: Consent - requires your active and specific consent
cookie_policy.consent_give_text: On your first visit to our website you will see a cookie banner where you can choose which cookie categories you want to accept. Your consent is:
cookie_policy.consent_voluntary_desc: You can use our website without marketing cookies
cookie_policy.consent_specific_desc: You can choose per category what you accept/reject
cookie_policy.consent_informed_desc: This policy explains what each cookie does
cookie_policy.consent_revocable_desc: You can withdraw your consent at any time
cookie_policy.consent_validity_text: Your cookie consent is valid for a period of 12 months. After this period we will ask you for consent again. You will then see the cookie banner again to set your preferences.
cookie_policy.consent_validity_change: In the meantime you can always change or withdraw your consent via the "Cookie Settings" link in the footer of every page, or by contacting us.
cookie_policy.consent_revoke_footer: Or use the cookie settings at the bottom of this page.
cookie_policy.thirdparty_text: Our website uses various external services that may place their own cookies. These "third-party cookies" are governed by the privacy policies of the respective service providers.
cookie_policy.thirdparty_google_analytics_desc: For website traffic analysis and user behavior insights
cookie_policy.thirdparty_google_ads_desc: For advertising campaigns and conversion tracking
cookie_policy.thirdparty_google_maps_desc: For location services and route maps to gardeners
cookie_policy.thirdparty_google_recaptcha_desc: For spam and bot protection on our contact forms
cookie_policy.thirdparty_social_text: Our website contains buttons and widgets from social media platforms:
cookie_policy.thirdparty_facebook_desc: For sharing content and Facebook Pixel tracking
cookie_policy.thirdparty_social_note: These services may collect information about your visit, even if you are not logged in to their service. Please consult their privacy policies for more information.
cookie_policy.thirdparty_security_text: For the security and optimization of our website we use:
cookie_policy.thirdparty_cloudflare_desc: For DDoS protection, CDN services and website performance
cookie_policy.thirdparty_sentry_desc: For error monitoring and performance tracking
cookie_policy.thirdparty_warning_text: Each third party has its own privacy policy and cookie policy. We recommend reading these to understand how your data is used by these parties.
cookie_policy.changes_text: We reserve the right to update this cookie policy from time to time to reflect changes in our use of cookies, technological developments, or changes in laws and regulations.
cookie_policy.changes_notification_text: For important changes to this cookie policy, we will notify you via:
cookie_policy.changes_notification_banner: A notice on our website (banner or pop-up)
cookie_policy.changes_notification_date: An update of the "last updated" date at the top of this policy
cookie_policy.changes_notification_email: An email to registered users (if applicable)
cookie_policy.changes_notification_social: Via our social media channels for significant changes
cookie_policy.changes_new_consent_text: When we introduce new types of cookies that require your consent, we will explicitly ask you for it via our cookie banner or a separate consent prompt.
cookie_policy.changes_review_text: We review this cookie policy at least annually to ensure it remains accurate and up-to-date. The last review date is listed at the top of this document.
cookie_policy.changes_advice: We advise you to regularly consult this cookie policy to stay informed of any changes. Your continued use of our website after publication of changes means you agree to the updated policy.
cookie_policy.changes_questions_suffix: if you have questions about changes to this cookie policy.
cookie_policy.security_text: We take the security of your personal data and cookie information very seriously. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data.
cookie_policy.security_encryption_desc: All data is secured with SSL/TLS encryption during transfer
cookie_policy.security_access_desc: Limited access to systems based on role requirements
cookie_policy.security_firewall_desc: 24/7 monitoring of our systems and networks
cookie_policy.security_updates_desc: Systems are regularly updated with security patches
cookie_policy.security_training_desc: All employees receive training on data protection
cookie_policy.security_access_mgmt_desc: Strict procedures for access to personal data
cookie_policy.security_audit_desc: Regular reviews of our security procedures
cookie_policy.security_cookie_text: For cookies we implement specific security measures:
cookie_policy.security_secure_flag_desc: Cookies are only sent over secure HTTPS connections
cookie_policy.security_httponly_desc: Functional cookies are protected against client-side scripts
cookie_policy.security_samesite_desc: Protection against CSRF attacks via SameSite cookie attributes
cookie_policy.security_minimal_desc: We only collect the minimum necessary information
cookie_policy.security_retention_desc: Cookies are automatically deleted after the set period
cookie_policy.security_breach_text: In the unlikely event of a data breach affecting your personal data, we will inform you within 72 hours in accordance with GDPR requirements.
cookie_policy.security_role_text: You can also contribute to the security of your data by:
cookie_policy.security_role_browser: Using an up-to-date browser with the latest security updates
cookie_policy.security_role_settings: Configuring your browser settings for optimal privacy
cookie_policy.security_role_report: Reporting suspicious activity on your account
cookie_policy.security_role_credentials: Keeping your login credentials (if applicable) safe
cookie_policy.contact_text: Do you have questions about our cookie policy or would you like to change your cookie preferences? Please feel free to contact us.
cookie_policy.contact_response: We aim to respond to your questions about cookies and privacy within 48 hours.
